HOUS.name: House
HOUS.definition: Specifies that the account is used to register trades executed for either the clearing member or its subsidiaries.

CLIE.name: Client
CLIE.definition: Specifies that the account is used to register trades executed for the clearing member's customers.

LIPR.name: Liquidity Provider
LIPR.definition: Specifies that the account is used to register trades executed for liquidity providers (also known as market maker) activities.
